column5: The bounded real-TiKV read path consumes Selection responses lazily, decodes projected signed-BIGINT rows, preserves warnings, and exposes immutable plan evidence before completion. Complete Go response iteration, memory accounting, runtime statistics, paging, feedback, and every non-bounded result type remain open.

One configured read-only table plan composes a real PD timestamp, TableScan-plus-Selection DAG, full signed-handle ranges, production routing and transport, cancellation, and result decoding. The full executor-builder matrix, dynamic catalog, writes, joins, aggregates, partitions, indexes, and non-BIGINT types remain open.

The bounded table reader sends one planner-built signed-BIGINT Selection over the maintained real PD, RegionCache, BatchCommands, retry, lock-recovery, and cancellation path without client-side filtering. Exact PK range detachment, partition readers, paging, feedback, index lookup, virtual columns, and full runtime statistics remain open.
